title: Finite quotient and fibre cohomology comparison
statement: Let f:X→Y be proper, Y locally Noetherian, F coherent, y∈Y and p≥0 [def-weil-proper-morphism, pqf-def-locnoeth, pqf-def-coherent]. Put A=O_(Y,y), X′=Spec A×_Y X, F′=g′*F, J=m_y O_(X′), C=H^p(X′,-) restricted to A, H=C(F′), M=(R^p f_*F)_y [def-pc-fibre-product, def-pc-module-pullback, def-nagata-extended-ideal, pqf-def-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-formal-functions-local-comparison]. There are an A-linear natural isomorphism b from the inverse system C(F′/J^(n+1)F′) to the infinitesimal fibre cohomology system restricted from the completed local ring [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module, def-weil-pbc-formal-fibre-cohomology], and A-linear maps r_n:H→H^p(X_n,F_n) with r_n(z)=b_n C(q_n)(z). For every A-linear a:M→H satisfying IsFormalFunctionsLocalComparison, (r_n).comp a satisfies IsFormalFunctionsTheta at every n [def-weil-pbc-formal-functions-local-comparison, def-weil-pbc-formal-fibre-cohomology]. This states no existence of a stalk equivalence.

proof.text: For n≥0 put A=O_y and X_n=Spec(A/m^(n+1))×_Y X. Pasting the defining pullback squares constructs i′_n:X_n→X′ with g′ i′_n=i_n. The quotient-base-change closed-immersion theorem identifies its ideal with J^(n+1), where J=m O_(X′). It is affine. Composition of tensor pullbacks canonically identifies i′_n*F′ with F_n, which is quasi-coherent. The same universal property gives i′_(n+1) j_n=i′_n for adjacent levels.

proof.text: The closed-immersion unit u_n:F′→i′_(n*)F_n is epi with kernel J^(n+1)F′. Its induced quotient isomorphism rho_n:F′/J^(n+1)F′→i′_(n*)F_n satisfies rho_n q_n=u_n. Apply H^p and the affine cohomology edge isomorphism to define b_n. Cohomology h-map functoriality identifies b_n H^p(q_n) with pullback along i′_n. Restricting completed scalars along A→A-completion evaluates to Ideal.Quotient.mk on each level, so b_n is A-linear with the scalar actions in the Lean statement.

proof.text: For adjacent levels, compare the two sheaf maps from F′/J^(n+2)F′ to i′_(n*)F_n. Precompose with the epimorphic quotient F′→F′/J^(n+2)F′. Both composites are u_n by compatibility of iterated tensor-pullback adjunction units and the defining transition h-map. Cancel the epi. Applying cohomology h-map functoriality proves that b_(n+1) and b_n commute with the adjacent transitions. Every arrow of ℕᵒᵖ is a composite of adjacent arrows, so the b_n assemble into the natural isomorphism b.

proof.text: Let r_n be cohomology pullback along i′_n; the scalar compatibility above and linearity of h-maps make it A-linear. The quotient-unit factorization proves r_n(z)=b_n H^p(q_n)(z). Given any a with IsFormalFunctionsLocalComparison, use its germ formula and compose with this pullback. All inverse-image neighbourhoods of y in Spec A are the whole spectrum. Pullback composition and the restriction-unit square therefore give the formula for IsFormalFunctionsTheta. Restricted injective resolutions exist; augmentation-preserving comparison maps induce the same maps on cohomology, so the formula holds for every resolution and every open choice in that predicate. No existence or bijectivity of a is used.

lean.statement:
theorem formalFunctions_finite_quotient_comparison {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsProper f] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (F : X.Modules)
    (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F) (y : Y) (p : ℕ) :
    let X' := pullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f
    let f' := pullback.fst (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f
    let F' := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F
    let J := (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      ((maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk y)).map
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Y.presheaf.stalk y))).inv.hom)).comap f'
    let C := RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X'.toRingedSpace p ⋙
      ModuleCat.restrictScalars
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Y.presheaf.stalk y))).inv ≫ f'.appTop).hom
    ∃ b : formalCompletionSystem J F' ⋙ C ≅
      formalFibreCohomologySystem f y F p ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars
        (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk y)
          (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk y)) (Y.presheaf.stalk y))),
    ∃ r : ∀ n : ℕ, formalFunctionsLocalCohomology f y F p →ₗ[Y.presheaf.stalk y]
      formalFibreCohomologyLocal f y F p n,
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (z : formalFunctionsLocalCohomology f y F p),
        r n z = (b.hom.app (op n)) ((C.map (formalModuleQuotientπ J (n + 1) F')) z)) ∧
      ∀ a : formalFunctionsStalk f y F p →ₗ[Y.presheaf.stalk y]
          formalFunctionsLocalCohomology f y F p,
        IsFormalFunctionsLocalComparison f y F p a →
          ∀ n : ℕ, IsFormalFunctionsTheta f y F p n ((r n).comp a)
